title: Get ISO 9001 certified
summary: Quality Management System certification against ISO 9001:2015

steps.title: Define your QMS scope
steps.detail: Decide which sites and processes the certification will cover — this sets the audit scope and fee band.

steps.title: Get the standard
steps.detail: Obtain ISO 9001:2015 from the e-store so you can work from the normative text.

action.label: Buy ISO 9001:2015
action.reason: Buying a standard requires an account so we can license the download.

steps.title: Implement & run an internal audit
steps.detail: Build your quality management system and run an internal audit. ESWASA training covers both.

action.label: Enrol in QMS training
action.reason: Enrolment is linked to your learner record.

steps.title: Apply for certification
steps.detail: Submit your application. Certification runs a Stage 1 (readiness) then Stage 2 (full) audit.

action.label: Apply for certification
action.reason: Applying creates a tracked case under your account.

steps.title: Certification & surveillance
steps.detail: On a successful audit your certificate is issued and listed on the public register, with annual surveillance.
